caption:
Tesla's Cybercab has no steering wheel or pedals, so they built an on-screen joystick that lets first responders move it when they need to.

This is Tesla training emergency services on exactly that, with both the Cybercab and the Model Y robotaxi. No driver seat to climb into, no wheel to grab. Just a screen and a joystick moving a two-ton car around a lot.

One of those practical problems nobody talks about until someone films the solution.
